تغلون (form I)
# تَغُلُّونَ (taḡullūna) /ta.ɣul.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# تُغَلُّونَ (tuḡallūna) /tu.ɣal.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
# تَغِلُّونَ (taḡillūna) /ta.ɣil.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
